mapper.sql: opp_id AS id,opp_nm AS name,cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",part_id AS "partId",sales_step_cd AS stage, win_prbl_rt AS probability,prbl_manual_yn AS "manualProbability",expct_amt AS amount, substring(bgn_plan_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(bgn_plan_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType", expct_prd_mcnt::int AS months,next_todo_cn AS "nextTask",next_todo_ddln_dt AS "nextDue",work_plc_addr AS workplace,rmrk AS memo, opp_stat_cd AS status,expct_prft_rt AS "profitRate",aprv_stat_cd AS "approvalStatus",aprv_prft_rt AS "approvedProfitRate", proj_id AS "projectId",rslt_dt AS "resultDate",lose_rsn_cd AS "lossReasonCode",lose_memo AS "lossMemo", reg_user_id AS "registeredBy",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",mod_user_id AS "modifiedBy",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sl_opp ORDER BY opp_id

SELECT tent_id::text AS id,opp_id AS "opportunityId",need_sn::int AS "needSn",dev_id AS "developerId", substring(bgn_ym,1,4)||'-'||substring(bgn_ym,5,2) AS "startMonth",tent_stat_cd AS status,src_scrn_id AS "sourceScreenId", proc_dttm AS "processedAt",reg_user_id AS "registeredBy",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",mod_user_id AS "modifiedBy",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt" FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY tent_id

SELECT hist_sn::int AS "histSn",aprv_act_cd AS action,prft_rt::text AS "profitRate",act_rsn AS reason,reg_user_id AS "registeredBy",reg_dttm AS "registeredAt" FROM tb_sl_aprv_hist WHERE opp_id=#{id} ORDER BY hist_sn
SELECT 'OPP:'||opp_id FROM tb_sl_opp ORDER BY opp_id
SELECT CASE WHEN last_value=999999999999999999 AND is_called THEN NULL ELSE nextval('sq_tb_sl_opp_id')::text END FROM sq_tb_sl_opp_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE clnt_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND clnt_type_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id=#{group} AND c.code=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y')

SELECT greatest(COALESCE((SELECT max(need_sn) FROM tb_sl_opp_need WHERE opp_id=#{id}),0), COALESCE((SELECT max(split_part(trgt_key,':',2)::int) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SL_OPP_NEED' AND split_part(trgt_key,':',1)=#{id} AND split_part(trgt_key,':',2) ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$'),0))::int
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sl_opp(opp_id,opp_nm,cust_clnt_id,part_id,sales_step_cd,win_prbl_rt,prbl_manual_yn,expct_amt,bgn_plan_ym,ctrt_type_cd,expct_prd_mcnt,next_todo_cn,next_todo_ddln_dt,work_plc_addr,rmrk,opp_stat_cd,expct_prft_rt,aprv_stat_cd,aprv_prft_rt,proj_id,rslt_dt,lose_rsn_cd,lose_memo,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_user_id,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{id},#{input.name},#{input.customerId},#{input.partId},#{input.stage},CAST(#{input.probability} AS numeric),CASE WHEN #{input.manualProbability} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,CAST(#{input.amount} AS numeric),replace(#{input.startMonth},'-',''),#{input.contractType},#{input.months},#{input.nextTask},#{input.nextDue},#{input.workplace},#{input.memo},'ING',#{rate},#{approval},#{approved},NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,#{actor},#{now},#{actor},#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_opp SET opp_nm=#{input.name},cust_clnt_id=#{input.customerId},part_id=#{input.partId},sales_step_cd=#{input.stage},win_prbl_rt=CAST(#{input.probability} AS numeric),prbl_manual_yn=CASE WHEN #{input.manualProbability} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,expct_amt=CAST(#{input.amount} AS numeric),bgn_plan_ym=replace(#{input.startMonth},'-',''),ctrt_type_cd=#{input.contractType},expct_prd_mcnt=#{input.months},next_todo_cn=#{input.nextTask},next_todo_ddln_dt=#{input.nextDue},work_plc_addr=#{input.workplace},rmrk=#{input.memo},expct_prft_rt=#{rate},aprv_stat_cd=#{approval},aprv_prft_rt=#{approved},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND opp_stat_cd='ING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sl_opp_need(opp_id,need_sn,job_cd,grade_cd,need_cnt,bgn_ym,prd_mcnt,mon_mm,expct_uprc,reg_user_id,reg_dttm,mod_user_id,mod_dttm) VALUES(#{id},#{need.needSn},#{need.jobCode},#{need.gradeCode},#{need.count},replace(#{need.startMonth},'-',''),#{need.months},CAST(#{need.monthlyMm} AS numeric),CAST(#{need.expectedRate} AS numeric),#{actor},#{now},#{actor},#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_opp_need SET job_cd=#{need.jobCode},grade_cd=#{need.gradeCode},need_cnt=#{need.count},bgn_ym=replace(#{need.startMonth},'-',''),prd_mcnt=#{need.months},mon_mm=CAST(#{need.monthlyMm} AS numeric),expct_uprc=CAST(#{need.expectedRate} AS numeric),mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{need.needSn}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_sl_opp_need WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn}
DELETE FROM tb_sl_tent_asgn WHERE opp_id=#{id} AND need_sn=#{needSn} AND tent_stat_cd IN ('REL','DROP')
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sl_tent_asgn SET bgn_ym=replace(#{value.startMonth},'-',''),tent_stat_cd=#{value.status},proc_dttm=#{value.processedAt},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tent_id=CAST(#{value.id} AS numeric) AND opp_id=#{value.opportunityId} AND tent_stat_cd='ACT'
